description: Ninety-six company- and document-blind Agent tasks over sixteen official CNINFO annual reports. Facts and pages are source-verified provisional gold; independent double review remains pending. Split: calibration. Expected behavior: abstain.
gold_policy: Gold was transcribed before the first Agent run. No evaluated Agent, DeepSeek answer, or LLM judge was used to create it. Exact values, deterministic behavior checks, and page-bound citations are scored locally.

cases.query: 请给出工商银行2025年实际不良贷款率、拨备覆盖率和资本充足率，并引用当前语料中的年报页码。
cases.gold_rationale: 冻结语料仅包含2023年和2024年年报，不能给出2025年实际全年值或伪造页码。
